## `foo`

<!-- div -->

<h3 id="foovalue"><code>foo(value)</code></h3>
[&#x24C8;](./#L12 "View in source") [&#x24C9;][1]

Logs markdown text to console

#### Arguments
1. `value` *(string)*: such as `"\\[bar\\]\\(baz\\)"`, "&#42;", "&#91;", "&#93;", "\*", "\[", or "\]"

#### Returns
*(void)*:

#### Example
```js
`foo("\\[bar\\]\\(baz\\)");`
```
